settings.title: Reset dashboards
settings.description: Booking dashboards can start counting fresh from a chosen moment. A reset only changes where counting starts. Nothing is deleted, and older records stay reachable through Show all history.
settings.notSetYet: Not reset yet. Counting all history.
settings.historyEmpty: No resets have been made yet.
settings.notePlaceholder: Why are you resetting this dashboard?
settings.noteHelp: Up to 500 characters. Saved with the reset in the history.
settings.confirmBody: Nothing is deleted. Bookings, disputes, claims, cancellations and KPI source data stay exactly as they are. From now on the dashboard counts from the moment you reset it. Older items stay reachable with Show all history.
settings.confirmOpenItems: Open and pending items are never hidden by a reset, so they keep appearing in their work queues.
settings.resetAllDone: All booking dashboards now count from this moment.
settings.undoDone: The previous baseline was restored for {dashboard}.
settings.error: Could not update the dashboards. Please try again.
